resources.title: Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant: The Foundation Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: What an Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant actually does: the core financials modules (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Subledger Accounting), a real Northfield Retail use case (moving from an old on-prem ERP to Oracle Fusion Financials), key job duties, Oracle Fusion Financials at a glance (manage transactions, record & report, track assets, manage cash, automate accounting, analyze & report), sample consultant tasks, and the career path and growth ladder from Fusion Consultant through Senior, Solution Consultant, to Fusion Architect with real salary ranges at each step.

resources.title: Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant: Core Financial Modules — GL, AP, AR, and Cash Management Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: A deep dive into the four core financial modules: General Ledger (the financial backbone), Accounts Payable (vendor invoices, approvals, payments), Accounts Receivable (customer invoicing, collections, cash application), and Cash Management (forecasting, monitoring, bank transactions). Covers the end-to-end financial process flow (create, process, reconcile, report, control), key configuration areas (chart of accounts, ledgers & legal entities, subledger accounting rules, approval workflows, accounting periods), a real month-end-close scenario, common AP/AR processes, hands-on lab examples, and best practices for consistent, well-documented configuration.

resources.title: Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant: Business Processes, Reporting, Security & Integrations Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: The end-to-end business side of the job: the five core business processes (Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, Asset to Retire, Plan to Perform), financial reporting & analytics (standard reports, OTBI/BI Publisher custom analytics, financial dashboards), security & access control (Fusion security model, predefined roles, role-based access, segregation of duties), integrations & data (FBDI data loading, upstream/downstream system integration, data validation), a structured testing & implementation process (plan test, execute test, validate results, go-live support), a real mid-size-company implementation scenario, and a realistic 12-week project roadmap.

resources.title: Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant: Certification, Projects, Career Growth & Next Steps Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Turning Oracle Fusion Financials skills into a real job: the certification path (Oracle Cloud ERP Financials 1Z0-1042 and recommended preparation), three real capstone projects (financial setup & configuration, process automation & reporting, an end-to-end financial solution), what you'll actually deliver (a working Fusion environment, configured business processes, financial reports and dashboards, an integration example, a published portfolio), the career growth roadmap from Functional Consultant through Senior Consultant to Fusion Financials Architect with real salary ranges, hiring prep for interviews and real scenarios, target roles and salary ranges, and a practical next-30-days action plan.
